source.title: assign message policy
source.reviewNotes: Apigee X AssignMessage operations are modeled by path: Add, Copy, Remove, Set, AssignTo, and AssignVariable. The UI default example includes an undocumented Properties subtree; Set/Payload permits arbitrary XML and is deliberately open. An Add/FormParam direct-child example conflicts with the grouped FormParams syntax, so both documented forms are accepted. Google authentication examples contain malformed closing tags; the consistently described nested forms are modeled. Cross-field request/response restrictions and AssignVariable precedence remain contextual rules not enforced statically.
